name: demo-smtp-google-window-image
description: Demo reCAPTCHA + SMTP microservices — Windows containers, 4 DMZ network zones

scripts.build: npm run build -w @demo/shared && npm run build -w @demo/gateway && npm run build -w @demo/recaptcha-service && npm run build -w @demo/smtp-service
scripts.docker:up:windows: npm run docker:zones:up && npm run docker:data:up && npm run docker:platform:up && npm run docker:backend:up && npm run docker:frontend:up
scripts.docker:up:linux: npm run docker:zones:up && npm run docker:data:up && npm run docker:platform:up && npm run docker:backend:linux:up && npm run docker:frontend:linux:up
scripts.docker:down: npm run docker:frontend:down && npm run docker:backend:down && npm run docker:platform:down && npm run docker:data:down && npm run docker:zones:down
scripts.docker:pull:up: docker compose --env-file .env -p backend -f docker/compose.backend.pull.yml pull && docker compose --env-file .env -p backend -f docker/compose.backend.pull.yml up -d && docker compose --env-file .env -p frontend -f docker/compose.frontend.pull.yml pull && docker compose --env-file .env -p frontend -f docker/compose.frontend.pull.yml up -d
